state:
**Goal `ext-grants` — a guest reaches only the files and hosts all three parties grant — Stage 2 is one item in.** M9. No floor is carried: the suites, the `.nvst` trees and `nv verify` are the safety net, and goals `ext-host` and `ext-compiler`'s tests stay green as tests of the tree.

The design is ADR 0246 § 7 and the user's, and the goal file's § *Standing decisions* answers every call a session meets. No record slot: a question the record leaves is settled under AGENTS.md's priority ordering and written in the module doc of the file that answers it.

**On disk:** `crates/nvs-ext/src/wasi.rs` — `bindgen!` over `wit/nvs-ext` with an inline `nvs:host/linked` world (cli, clocks, random, filesystem), `wasi:io` mapped to `wasmtime-wasi-io` 48 (no tokio; `cargo tree -i tokio` shows only `hyper`'s old route). `LINKED` lists what is linked, `wasi::link` runs after `handle::link` in `Host::new`, `Guest` carries `pub(crate) wasi: wasi::Context` (a `ResourceTable`), and `Loader::imports` admits a WASI import only from `LINKED`, so `wasi:http` is refused at load until Stage 5 links it. `crates/nvs-ext/tests/wasi.rs` probes every WASI interface in the WIT and requires the linkable set to equal `LINKED`. `crates/nvs-ext/tests/load.rs` has `a_component_importing_a_linked_wasi_interface_loads`.

**Placeholders the rest of the group replaces**, all in `crates/nvs-ext/src/wasi.rs`: stdout/stderr are `Discard`, the monotonic clock is the process's and its `subscribe-*` pollables are `Ready` at once (a guest's sleep returns immediately), the wall clock is `SystemTime`, random is `rand::rng()` with no seed hook, and `exit` traps with a plain `wasmtime::Error`. `wasi::Context` is built with `Default` at `crates/nvs-ext/src/call.rs:709`, so the request's log, clock and generator must reach it through `Request`/`Budget`.

next.note: one file set: `crates/nvs-ext/src/wasi.rs`, `crates/nvs-ext/src/call.rs`, `crates/nvs-ext/tests/wasi.rs`, and the trait the request hands the host (`Budget` in `crates/nvs-ext/src/call.rs`).

items.text: **An empty context** — no environment and no arguments (already true at `crates/nvs-ext/src/wasi.rs:155`); stdin empty; stdout and stderr go to the calling request's log at `debug`, with the extension's name as the channel: replace `Discard` at `crates/nvs-ext/src/wasi.rs:220` with a stream that writes through what the request gives `Guest` at `crates/nvs-ext/src/call.rs:709`. Tests `a_guest_sees_no_environment_no_arguments_and_no_directories`, `a_guest_reading_stdin_reads_nothing`, `a_guest_writing_to_stdout_and_stderr_reaches_the_request_log_at_debug` in `crates/nvs-ext/tests/wasi.rs`, guests as component WAT. `rule:packaging/a-guest-has-no-ambient-authority`.

**The request's clock and generator** — the wall clock is `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/time.rs:3537`'s `wall_clock`, so a fixed test clock reaches the guest; random bytes are `Core\Random`'s generator with a seed hook for the test. Replaces `crates/nvs-ext/src/wasi.rs:258` and `crates/nvs-ext/src/wasi.rs:299`. `Ready` at `crates/nvs-ext/src/wasi.rs:245` needs a real deadline pollable woken by the request's timer, never a thread sleep. Tests `a_guest_reading_the_wall_clock_under_a_fixed_clock_reads_the_fixed_time`, `a_guest_drawing_random_bytes_under_a_seed_draws_the_seeded_bytes`.

**`exit` traps, and a libc-shaped guest runs** — `exit` at `crates/nvs-ext/src/wasi.rs:169` throws `ExtensionError` and the next call is fresh (`rule:packaging/a-guest-crash-throws`, `crates/nvs-ext/tests/failure.rs`); a guest importing every linked interface instantiates and runs a call. Tests `a_guest_calling_exit_throws_extension_error_and_the_next_call_succeeds`, `a_libc_shaped_guest_loads_and_runs_with_no_authority`.
**`nvs:ext/log` and `nvs:ext/settings`** — the stage's second check, `nvs-ext-the-nvs-ext-imports-are-linked`; linked beside `handle::link` at `crates/nvs-ext/src/call.rs:404`. ADR 0246 § 2 and § 9.

backlog: Stage 3, the grant: `[[extension]] grants` in `crates/nvs-config/src/tree.rs`, and the effective-set intersection (`rule:security/extension-grants-are-an-intersection`).
Stage 4, files: real `Descriptor` resources mapped with `with:` in `crates/nvs-ext/src/wasi.rs`, through `Core\IO`'s canonicalise-then-prefix check.
Stage 5, outbound HTTP: bindgen `wasi:http` and add it to `LINKED`; the `wasi:http/types@0.2.12` row in `crates/nvs-ext/tests/load.rs`'s refused list then moves out.
`wit/nvs-ext/world.wit`'s doc says file access and HTTP "are linked for every guest"; true once Stage 5 lands.
